# Hash-pinned LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, the OpenAI Agents SDK and Pydantic AI for the Python job of .github/workflows/ci.yml
# (pip --require-hashes). Only the Python 3.12 / ubuntu-latest entry installs them: the
# tests that run the integrations through the real frameworks
# (packages/zn-gate-py/tests/test_langchain_real.py and test_llamaindex_real.py) run
# there and skip on the other entries. tests/test_native_tool_hooks.py runs the native tool hooks
# through Google ADK, the OpenAI Agents SDK and Pydantic AI; the CI step that runs it sets
# ZN_REQUIRE_FRAMEWORKS=1, so a framework that is not installed fails the run instead of skipping.
#
# Dependabot opens security updates only for this directory (version updates are off).
# Regenerate with uv from
# these inputs, written to a scratch file (for example requirements.in) next to this one:
#   langchain-core>=1.3.3,<2
#   llama-index-core>=0.14,<0.15
#   google-adk==2.14.0
#   openai-agents==0.24.0
#   pydantic-ai-slim==2.58.0
# then run, as one command:
#   uv pip compile requirements.in --python-version 3.12 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 \
#     --generate-hashes --no-header --no-annotate --exclude-newer <date> \
#     -c ci-test-requirements.txt -o ci-framework-test-requirements.txt
# The -c keeps the shared packages at the versions ci-test-requirements.txt pins.
# <date> is two weeks ago for the LangChain and LlamaIndex pins; google-adk 2.14.0 is newer than that,
# so the last compile used 2026-11-08. websockets is pinned by google-adk (below 16).
# google-adk 2.14.0 allows opentelemetry-api up to 1.45.2: google-adk 2.12.0 capped it at 1.42.1, which is affected by
# GHSA-xcq7-p3pf-p88h (fixed in 1.45.1).
